subject: pytest confirms CHANGELOG.md contains an Unreleased note for the approved mascot
source:
uv run python -c 'from pathlib import Path
text = Path("CHANGELOG.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
unreleased, _, _ = text.partition("## [Unreleased]")
rest = _.split("## [", 1)[0]
assert "approved mascot" in rest
print("unreleased mascot note present")'
